_readme: Text for the homepage, How we work and About pages. Keep every statement true for your business today.

hero.lead: Zee Telephonics is your outsourced team for customer support, outbound calling, lead generation and back-office work, run with care for your customers and your brand.

process.title: Discovery call
process.text: We learn about your business, your customers and the work you want to hand over.

process.title: Proposal and scope
process.text: You receive a clear scope: tasks, hours, tools, reporting and pricing. Nothing starts until you agree.

process.title: Onboarding
process.text: We set up access to your tools, learn your scripts and processes, and run a trial period with close review.

process.title: Go-live and improve
process.text: Work goes live with regular reports and check-ins, and we refine the process with you over time.

principles.title: Your voice, your playbook
principles.text: We follow your scripts, tone and escalation rules, so customers experience one consistent brand.

principles.title: Transparent reporting
principles.text: You see what was done and what happened, in reports agreed with you at the start.

principles.title: One point of contact
principles.text: A named contact handles your account, so questions and changes go to someone who knows your setup.

principles.title: Flexible engagement
principles.text: Start with one service and adjust the scope as your needs change.

about.mission: Our mission is to help businesses serve their customers better by taking on the conversations and the operational work that keep a company running.
about.story: Zee Telephonics was set up to give growing businesses access to dependable outsourced support, without the cost and time of building every team in-house.

values.title: Respect
values.text: Every customer we speak to is treated as your customer.

values.title: Clarity
values.text: Clear scopes, clear reports and no surprises.

values.title: Care
values.text: We protect the data and access you trust us with.

values.title: Improvement
values.text: We review the work regularly and look for ways to do it better.
